Privacy

Lending Anchor (lendinganchor.com) collects only what you type into the request form and ordinary server logs. It uses that information to forward a request to independent lenders and to operate the site.

This brand does not sell your form answers as a standalone list. Lenders who receive a request apply their own privacy practices once they contact you.

You can ask questions at info@lendinganchor.com.

Lending Anchor is a request-referral service, not a lender. It does not approve loans, set rates, or send funds.

Keep using lendinganchor.com as this brand’s public address.
